suggestions.title: Hand it to ten friendly testers
suggestions.summary: Pick people who will actually use it and watch them try.
suggestions.plain: Give the first version to about ten people you trust and watch them use it.

suggestions.title: Write down what tripped them up
suggestions.summary: One list, in their words, of every place they hesitated.
suggestions.plain: Keep one list, in their own words, of every place those testers got stuck.

suggestions.title: Put it behind a real web address
suggestions.summary: Move off the local machine before anyone is invited.
suggestions.plain: Move it off your own computer and onto a real web address before you invite anyone.

suggestions.title: Get told when it falls over
suggestions.summary: A single alert, to one inbox, when the site stops answering.
suggestions.plain: Set up one alert so you hear about it yourself when the site stops answering.
